name: CI

on:
  merge_group:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * sun"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-up-to-dateness:
    outputs:
      is-up-to-date: ${{ steps.main.outputs.is-up-to-date }}

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - id: main
        uses: trailofbits/check-up-to-dateness@v2

  test:
    needs: [check-up-to-dateness]

    if: needs.check-up-to-dateness.outputs.is-up-to-date != 'true'

    strategy:
      fail-fast: ${{ github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}
      matrix:
        environment: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        index: [crates-index, tame-index]
        test:
          [
            ci,
            dogfood,
            general,
            rustsec_advisories,
            rustsec_issues,
            snapbox_mock_github,
            snapbox_real_github,
          ]

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.environment }}

    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash

    env:
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
      GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE: 1

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: |
            # smoelius: Do NOT cache ~/.cache/cargo-unmaintained. Sure, it makes CI faster. But it
            # also makes it harder to tell when test files need to be updated.
            # ~/.cache/cargo-unmaintained/
            ~/.cargo/bin/
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2.87.29
        with:
          tool: cargo-audit, cargo-hack, cargo-udeps

      - name: Install CI tools
        if: ${{ matrix.test == 'ci' }}
        run: |
          rustup update          --no-self-update
          rustup install nightly --no-self-update
          rustup component add clippy  --toolchain nightly
          rustup component add rustfmt --toolchain nightly
          cargo install cargo-dylint dylint-link || true
          cargo install cargo-license            || true
          cargo install cargo-supply-chain       || true

      - name: Install general tools
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-nested             || true

      - name: Enable verbose logging
        if: ${{ runner.debug == 1 }}
        run: echo 'VERBOSE=1' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Fetch dependencies
        run: cargo nested fetch

      - name: Compute features
        run: |
          # `crates-index` is a default feature, so `--no-default-features` is needed for the
          # `tame-index` leg to actually use `tame-index`.
          FEATURES="--no-default-features --features=on-disk-cache,${{ matrix.index }}"
          # The externally influenced tests are slow and depend on the network. Running them on
          # just one platform is sufficient.
          if [[ '${{ matrix.environment }}' = 'ubuntu-latest' ]]; then
            FEATURES="$FEATURES --features=test-ei"
            if [[ '${{ github.event_name }}' = 'schedule' || '${{ github.event_name }}' = 'workflow_dispatch' ]] ||
              git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} | grep 'rustsec' >/dev/null
            then
              FEATURES="$FEATURES --features=test-rustsec"
            fi
          fi
          echo "FEATURES=$FEATURES" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build
        # smoelius: Build the whole workspace. This performs some unnecessary work, but it ensures
        # that all packages are built.
        run: cargo build $FEATURES --workspace

      - name: Test
        run: cargo test $FEATURES --test ${{ matrix.test }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  all-checks:
    needs: [test]

    # smoelius: From "Defining prerequisite jobs"
    # (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-jobs/using-jobs-in-a-workflow#defining-prerequisite-jobs):
    # > If you would like a job to run even if a job it is dependent on did not succeed, use the
    # > `always()` conditional expression in `jobs.<job_id>.if`.
    if: ${{ always() }}

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check results
        if: ${{ contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}
        run: exit 1

[package]
name = "ci"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[dev-dependencies]
assert_cmd = "2.2"
cargo_metadata = "0.23"
elaborate = "2.0"
regex = "1.13"
serde_json = "1.0"
similar-asserts = "2.0"
supply_chain = "0.2"
tempfile = "3.27"
toml_edit = "0.25"
walkdir = "2.5"
yaml_serde = "0.10"

testing = { path = "../testing" }

[lints]
workspace = true

[package]
name = "cargo-unmaintained-with-mock-github"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0"
cargo-unmaintained = { path = "..", features = ["__mock_github"] }

[package]
name = "testing"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0"
elaborate = "2.0"
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
snapbox = "1.2"
tempfile = "3.27"
toml = "1.1"

[lints]
workspace = true

[package]
name = "private-registry"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
crates-io = { path = "crates-io" }
my-registry = { path = "my-registry" }

[package]
name = "timeout"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

# smoelius: https://stackoverflow.com/a/56459603
# repository = "https://httpstat.us/200?sleep=300000" # 5 minutes

# smoelius: httpstat.us is returning 503s.
# smoelius: https://stackoverflow.com/a/100859
repository = "https://www.google.com:81"

[package]
name = "crates-io"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

# smoelius: The next `dependencies` entry should match what is in ../my-registry/Cargo.toml, except
# that file's entry has a `registry` field.

[dependencies]
syn = { version = "1.0" }

[package]
name = "my-registry"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

# smoelius: The next `dependencies` entry should match what is in ../crates-io/Cargo.toml, except
# that file's entry does not have a `registry` field.

[dependencies]
syn = { version = "1.0", registry = "my-registry" }
